cells.quote: Further, a Cox test to compare the non-nested linear models showed that the full RPM model fit the data significantly better than the raw score model (z = −17.470 p < 0.001). O.outcome_detail: total response time during motor-sequence acquisition

cells.quote: As anticipated, online performance was consistent with the common observation that RP-Sham results in better performance during acquisition than IP-Sham. This was confirmed by the 2 (Group: IP-Sham, RP-Sham) × 9 (Block) analysis of variance (ANOVA) with repeated measures on the last factor. It revealed a significant main effect of group, F (1, 272) = 30.60, p < .0001, ηp 2 = 0.1), resulting from higher TT for the IP-Sham participants compared to their RP-Sham counterparts for all training blocks (Fig. 2a).
cells.note: Higher total response time indicates poorer performance; therefore interleaved practice was worse than repetitive practice during acquisition.
